stickyIntegrityGuard.behavior: Validate an available header even while status is pending. Preserve a mismatched-header integrity error across later unavailable nodes unless another node provides the exact confirmed header. No unconfirmed replay is initiated for an integrity failure.

limitations: No real network requests, actual wallet-extension approvals, uploads, payments, ArNS edits, Worker calls or blocked Rigel access were performed.
Web Locks and IndexedDB behavior are controlled local models; actual multi-tab browser behavior and Node22 acceptance belong to final root CI.
Commit-abort tests exercise request success followed by IndexedDB transaction abort, not physical power-loss durability.
If the signed-result commit is lost, the stored signing intent remains unresolved and another wallet prompt is blocked; automatic recovery of the missing response is not claimed.
Six Merkle sizes exercise the actual client mock POST path; the near-10MiB case checks all 40 proofs without adding a second full mock-server archive copy.
Quote/network assertions do not prove real fee acceptance, delivery or settlement.
Changed source requires a fresh exact CI artifact before publication; the historical 17 Nov accepted ZIP does not contain these fixes.
